messages:
Nora Patel: quick sync: i'm opening a docs PR to clarify structured-output expectations for function/tool calling. goal: clearer examples + migration notes for teams returning arrays. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123
Devon Lee: nice. what are the exact recommendations? envelope vs items-only?
Nora Patel: recommendation: prefer an object envelope when returning heterogeneous fields or metadata (e.g., {"result": [...], "meta": {}}). use items/array schema when responses are strictly homogeneous lists.
Sam Ortiz: can we add a short lint rule in CI that flags bare top-level arrays in examples directory? keeps examples consistent.
Nora Patel: yes, planning to add a docs linter rule and a migration subsection. will include a suggested pre-commit snippet for teams.
Alex Wu: SDK impact? i'll add a tiny helper parse_with_schema(response, schema, {legacy:false}) that documents fallback coercion but defaults to strict.
Devon Lee: include a code example showing coercion and explicit opt-in to legacy mode + a deprecation timeline. also add links from the function-calling page to the schema guide.
Sam Ortiz: also fixed four outdated anchors and one dead external link in the PR. left notes on a couple wording bits.
Nora Patel: thanks. Docs-bot: lint check queued.
docs-bot: docs lint passed for PR 5123 :white_check_mark:
Nora Patel: added two examples: structured-envelope-chat.json and embeddings-list-legacy.json. kept messages short. please review, aiming to merge tomorrow morning so Alex can cut an SDK patch.
Alex Wu: will hold the SDK branch until docs merge. if anything blocks, i'll delay the release by a day.
Sam Ortiz: review finished 44d small wording nit fixed.
Nora Patel: merging after CI green. will follow up with a short migration checklist in docs/migration/tool-calling.md.
Devon Lee: i'll draft the checklist entry and link to the snippet in the playground for quick testing.
Nora Patel: great, thanks all!
